v. cause to feel relaxed
v. become less tense, less formal, or less restrained, and assume a friendlier manner
zh: vi. 放松, 松懈, 松弛, 变从容, 休息, 休养
vt. 使松弛, 缓和, 使松懈, 使休息
examples: Relax, tomorrow will be another day.
Be relaxed and put the other person at ease.

defsEn: v. keep under control
keep in check
v. to close within bounds, limit or hold back from movement
v. hold back
zh: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束缚
examples: He could not restrain his excitement.
I told Jim to restrain himself from drinking too much.

defsEn: n. a drastic and far-reaching change in ways of thinking and behaving
n. the overthrow of a government by those who are governed
zh: n. 革命, 大变革, 旋转, 转数, 循环
examples: A revolution is not a dinner party.
The revolution ushered in a new era.

defsEn: s. incapable of or resistant to bending
s. incapable of compromise or flexibility
a. designating an airship or dirigible having a form maintained by a stiff unyielding frame or structure
zh: a. 坚硬的, 刚性的, 严格的, 精密的, 刻板的
examples: I was brought up under rigid discipline.
Rigid wheels give sufficient stability to a low-speed vehicle steered by outside forces.

defsEn: v. send documents or materials to appropriate destinations
v. send via a specific route
v. divert in a specified direction
zh: n. 路径, 途径, 路线
vt. 确定路线, 按规定路线发送
examples: This route will lead you to the station.
This route will take you to the station.

defsEn: n. an outline or synopsis of a play (or, by extension, of a literary work)
n. a setting for a work of art or literature
n. a postulated sequence of possible events
zh: n. 剧本提纲, 情节, 剧本, 方案, 事态
examples: The entire scenario is an undercover sting run by the Egyptian police.
Algeria is facing a bleak scenario.

defsEn: n. a particular environment or walk of life
n. any spherically shaped artifact
n. the geographical area in which one nation is very influential
n. a solid figure bounded by a spherical surface (including the space it encloses)
zh: n. 球, 球面, 球体, 天体, 地球仪, 范围
vt. 包围, 使成球体, 放入球内
examples: Our sphere of influence has expanded so much since then.
The highest sphere of life is mathematics.

defsEn: n. an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
v. rank or order as less important or consider of less value
v. make subordinate, dependent, or subservient
a. lower in rank or importance
zh: n. 属下, 附属物
a. 下级的, 次要的, 附属的
vt. 使居下位, 使服从
examples: Can you describe the ideal supervisor-subordinate relationship?
He is able to subordinate passion to reason.

defsEn: n. a quantity added (e.g. to make up for a deficiency)
v. add as a supplement to what seems insufficient
v. serve as a supplement to
zh: n. 补充物, 增刊, 补充, 补遗, 补编, 附录, 补角
vt. 补充, 增补
examples: He supplemented his lecture with a booklet.
If there's a shortage, we'll supplement it.

defsEn: v. hang freely
v. cause to be held in suspension in a fluid
v. bar temporarily
from school, office, etc.
v. make inoperative or stop
zh: vt. 悬, 吊, 使悬浮, 暂停, 中止, 推迟
vi. 暂停, 中止, 悬浮, 停止偿付债务
examples: He was suspended from school for a week for bad conduct.
Suspending the trial is out of the question.

defsEn: n. a cooperative unit (especially in sports)
n. two or more draft animals that work together to pull something
v. form a team
zh: n. 队, 组
vt. 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组
vi. 驾驶卡车, 协作
examples: Which team do you predict will win the game?
That team will be tough to beat.

defsEn: n a worker (especially in an office) hired on a temporary basis
a not permanent
not lasting
s lacking continuity or regularity
zh: a. 暂时的, 临时的
n. 临时工, 临时雇员
examples: How temporary will this situation be?
A temporary stage was set up in the park.

defsEn: n. a device that activates or releases or causes something to happen
n. an act that sets in motion some course of events
v. release or pull the trigger on
zh: n. 触发器, 扳机
vt. 触发, 发射, 引起
vi. 松开扳柄
examples: What triggers this type of anxiety?
I had my finger on the trigger, ready to fire.

defsEn: v. become one
zh: v. 统一, 使成一体
examples: Why did they unify their development tools?
Algeria has a unified national healthcare system.

defsEn: v. fail to agree with
be in violation of
as of rules or patterns
v. destroy
zh: vt. 违犯, 亵渎, 违反, 侵犯, 妨碍
examples: If you violate the terms of service, your account will be suspended.
They violated the terms of the contract.

defsEn: n. a vivid mental image
n. the perceptual experience of seeing
n. a religious or mystical experience of a supernatural appearance
zh: n. 视觉, 眼光, 视力, 幻想
vt. 梦见, 想象, 显示
examples: He told us that visions would appear to him during the night.
He had a vision for the future.
